missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Приём' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'будет'. 'Торжественный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'вечером' sets the time. A clean event statement.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Приём' is inanimate masculine, so the accusative matches the nominative form. 'Устроил' takes it as the direct object, and 'пышный' agrees as masculine. A natural social sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Приёма' takes the genitive after 'после' to mark the time reference. 'Пришли' agrees with the plural subject 'гости'. A useful temporal pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К приёму' uses the dative form 'приёму' after 'к' to mark what is being prepared for. 'Важному' agrees in the masculine dative. A common planning frame.

Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Перед приёмом' uses the instrumental form 'приёмом' after 'перед' to mean before the event. 'Надела' agrees with the feminine subject. A natural time frame.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'На приёме' uses the prepositional form 'приёме' after 'на' to mark the setting. 'Много гостей' uses the genitive plural. A common event description.

missions.phrase: Я записался на приём к врачу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'На приём' uses the accusative after 'на' to mark the appointment one signs up for. 'К врачу' adds the dative recipient. A high-frequency medical phrase.

Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Приём' is nominative as the subject, here in the sense of a method or technique. 'Этот' agrees as masculine and 'эффективный' is the agreeing adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A clean descriptive card.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Приёмы' is the accusative plural object of 'ведёт'; for inanimate nouns the accusative plural matches the nominative plural. 'По утрам' adds the schedule. A practical work sentence.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Приёмы' is the nominative plural subject of 'бывают'. 'Дипломатические' agrees in the plural, and 'скучными' is the instrumental predicate the verb takes. A natural generalisation.
